LanguageData.LP_Sub_DrunkenWay.label: Way of the Drunken Master
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DrunkenWay.description: A swaying monk: hard to hit, turns melee blows aside and staggers the attacker, numb to pain and fear, and finally strikes every adjacent enemy twice in one breath.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_KenseiWay.label: Way of the Kensei
LanguageData.LP_Sub_KenseiWay.description: A monk whose weapon is part of the body: more accurate and nimble with a melee weapon in hand, the weapon pierces armor and hits harder, ki sharpens the blade, and finally any hit may deal double damage.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Zealot.label: Path of the Zealot
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Zealot.description: A barbarian who fights for a god: melee burns with divine fury while raging, a steadfast mind, a war cry that fires up nearby allies, and finally less damage taken while raging.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Ancestral.label: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Ancestral.description: A barbarian who calls ancestral spirits to protect companions: enemies hit while raging hurt others less, spirits shield nearby allies, ancestral wisdom speeds learning, and finally the shielded damage strikes back.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_FeyWanderer.label: Fey Wanderer
LanguageData.LP_Sub_FeyWanderer.description: A ranger who has walked the Feywild: weapon hits carry mind-rattling force, a charming and steady mind, a beguiling mist that rattles nearby enemies, and finally a step through the mist.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_HorizonWalker.label: Horizon Walker
LanguageData.LP_Sub_HorizonWalker.description: A ranger who guards the planar borders: weapon hits add force damage, steps into the Ethereal to avoid attacks, jumps around the battlefield while striking, and finally a half-spectral body halves a hit at intervals.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleWildfire.label: Circle of Wildfire
LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleWildfire.description: A druid who knows fire both destroys and renews: fiery seeds burn and ignite enemies, a wildfire spirit strengthens druid spells, enemies dying nearby turn into healing embers, and finally rebirth in flame when struck down.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.label: College of Glamour
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.description: A performer with fey charm: a mantle of inspiration shields allies, enthralling performances smooth social dealings and trade, a mantle of majesty brings an enemy to its knees, and finally an unbreakable majesty.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.0.label: magical secrets
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.0.tips.4: Wizard level 7: a line of lightning.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.0.tips.7: Cleric level 3: cures disease and poison.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.0.tips.9: Druid level 1: entangles a group of enemies.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.0.tips.11: Warlock level 7: more damage, lower saves.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.1.label: magical secrets II
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.1.tips.4: Wizard level 7: a line of lightning.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.1.tips.7: Cleric level 3: cures disease and poison.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.1.tips.9: Druid level 1: entangles a group of enemies.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.1.tips.11: Warlock level 7: more damage, lower saves.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.1.tips.12: Cleric level 10: heals all nearby allies.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.1.tips.13: Wizard level 10: raises a stone wall.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.1.tips.14: Druid level 10: nearby animals go berserk.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Glamour.choices.1.tips.15: Sorcerer level 10: a group of enemies wander in a daze.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_BountyHunter.label: Way of the Bounty Hunter
LanguageData.LP_Sub_BountyHunter.description: A gunslinger who never lets a target go: a bounty mark raises damage against it, quick feet and a steady aim, a hobbling shot slows runners, a payoff when the target dies, and finally dead or alive.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_PsiSeer.label: Seer
LanguageData.LP_Sub_PsiSeer.description: A psion who sees the next second ahead: foresight dodging, warning allies of danger, exposing an enemy's openings, a third eye guarding the mind, fully avoiding an attack at intervals, and finally rewinding the wounds of nearby allies. Always-prepared spells: shield, mind spike, mirror image (level 3), confusion (level 7), scrying (level 9).
